scripts.build: rm -rf dist && bun build ./index.html --outdir=dist --minify && cp -R img dist/img
scripts.build:no-fluid: rm -rf dist && bun build ./index.html --outdir=dist --minify --define 'process.env.ENABLE_MAGMA_FLUID="false"' && cp -R img dist/img
scripts.build:no-plate-motion: rm -rf dist && bun build ./index.html --outdir=dist --minify --define 'process.env.ENABLE_PLATE_MOTION="false"' && cp -R img dist/img
